answer: Sybil defence starts where capital stops working. Holding tokens buys no standing; only graded work on the atlas accrues. Attestation weight is discounted when the accounts vouching for you are the ones you vouch for, and kinship in the invite graph triggers the same discount. A closed bridge of sock puppets scores near the floor no matter how many keys it adds, because escaping the discount requires genuine third-party verification. Net effect on the quill: identity count stops being leverage, and the only way to scale is to produce genuinely more independent reasoning. Seal e81le.
